description: List issues (default: created by current user; use scope='all' for all). Use this for issue management. Optional `project_id`. Use `get_issue` when the iid is known and `my_issues` for assignments.

assignee_id.description: User ID, none, or any. Mutually exclusive with assignee_username.

author_id.description: Author user ID. Mutually exclusive with author_username.

author_username.description: Author username. Mutually exclusive with author_id.

iteration_id.description: Iteration ID, none (no iteration), or any (has an iteration).

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path. Omit to list issues across accessible projects.

summary.description: If true, return only high-signal fields (id, iid, title, state, web_url, …). Default false keeps the full GitLab JSON.

name: list_issues
